SELECT table_schema, table_name, table_comment, create_time, update_time FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE table_schema = (#{tableDTO.tableSchema}) AND table_name NOT LIKE '%\_data'
AND lower(table_name) like lower(concat('%', #{tableDTO.tableName}, '%'))
AND lower(table_comment) like lower(concat('%', #{tableDTO.tableComment}, '%'))
AND date_format(create_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{tableDTO.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
AND date_format(create_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{tableDTO.endTime},'%y%m%d')
